title: 96. Reverse Nodes in k-Group

examples.explanation: Reversing every 2 nodes in the linked list [1,2,3,4,5] gives [2,1,4,3,5].
Reversing every 3 nodes in the linked list [1,2,3,4,5] gives [3,2,1,4,5].
Reversing every 2 nodes in the linked list [1,2] gives [2,1].
